elements.description: A "the model is working" pill: a spinner and a label that walks through phases, then a check and a done label.

properties.name: phases
properties.description: Labels to walk through, one after another

properties.name: phase
properties.description: The phase shown. The timer moves it on unless a tc-phase-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: manual
properties.description: The phase is set from outside (e.g. from stream events): no timer

properties.name: startedAt
properties.description: When the work started, in epoch ms – the done label counts from here. Defaults to when the loader connected (or work restarted)

properties.name: loop
properties.description: Start over after the last phase instead of holding it – at most twice, then it holds the last phase (WCAG 2.2.2)

properties.name: done
properties.description: Finished: the spinner turns into a check and the label into doneLabel

properties.name: doneLabel
properties.description: Label once done – a string, or a function that gets the seconds since the loader started

properties.name: size
properties.description: "md" is the default pill; "sm" is smaller, e.g. inside a chat bubble

properties.name: variant
properties.description: "pill" = bordered capsule, "plain" = just the spinner and the label, e.g. inside a chat bubble

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-phase-change
events.description: The timer moved to another phase (detail: { phase: number }); cancelable – the phase stays if a listener calls preventDefault()

props.name: phase
props.description: Show a specific phase instead of advancing on a timer – e.g. from your stream events (controlled when defined)

props.name: defaultPhase
props.description: The phase to start from when uncontrolled; the timer moves on from there

props.name: onPhaseChange
props.description: Reports each phase the timer moves to
